title: Sanctions screening — Q2 2026 update for cross-border holdings
content: No new sanctions actions affect any current Contoso-issued fund vehicle. For directly-held single-name positions, the standard CPI screening cadence (weekly batch + on-trade gating) remains in force. Reminder: any new client onboarding a directly-held EM single-name position must include the source-of-wealth supplement for the underlying issuer's domicile. Foundation and pension clients with cross-border operating exposure should be reminded of the periodic screening attestation due each Q2 — CPI Compliance will issue the templated cover letter on 2026-05-15.
